description: A reproducible harness that compares Jev with frontier LLMs on the same structured decision tasks. The author reports 88.2% accuracy for Jev and 86.8% for gpt-5.6-luna.
how_used_jev: Jev and each LLM answer the same typed questions about the same state. The harness scores accuracy, calibration, consistency, latency, cost, and schema validity.
